current_flow: mis-selection ships a versioned repo-owned Mapping Master (selection records keyed by department/function/canonical plant owning the aliases + mis_format, plus entry records mapping cost_center+gl_code to a mis_line with provisional/reason), whose nine unresolved Actual triples and any unmapped Budget GL land in an explicit unmapped-GL bucket so both sides reconcile to 88 DUB rows. Two server-owned routes — options and run — expose it: run accepts ONLY the four selectors, so a client can never widen a report; the server resolves, authorizes and invokes the EXISTING governed executor. The governed path is narrowed, not forked: actual_src filters the resolved triples on actual_by_key_month and re-aggregates to (gl_code, month) before the FULL OUTER JOIN, and budget_src is restricted to the resolved GL set at its unchanged grain. A gated D-0008 proof pins the completeness invariant and no-fan-out; the UI is one authenticated page using native selects.
new_abstractions: a versioned repo-owned Mapping Master with selection records (aliases + format, singular alias authority) and entry records (cost_center+gl -> mis_line, provisional + reason)
the unmapped-GL bucket applied symmetrically to Actual AND Budget so the slice reconciles
a server-owned options/run API boundary where the run request cannot carry scope
selection-aware narrowing of the existing governed path (triple-filtered actual_src on actual_by_key_month; budget_src restricted to the resolved GL set)
gaps: The cold read reported the requirements grill as missing, so the plan could not pass its plan gate.
The draft had no Decisions reconciliation section despite 18 active decisions, failing the plan contract.
The new API lacked named request/response DTOs and documented Swagger error responses, which the constitution requires for fresh code.
Surface Impact omitted the changed test/config surfaces and every unchanged-by-design reason, and the Verify Plan gave no exact falsifying commands.

The API boundary let a client supply resolved scope: the UI needs master-backed selector options, triples cannot ride as ordinary filters (silently dropped), and a client able to send scope could WIDEN a report — an escalation seam.

Budget slice semantics were wrong: the plan filtered only actual_src, but budget_src admits every active DUB budget GL and the FULL OUTER JOIN preserves budget-only rows, so a mapped selection could return Budget outside its resolved GL set — breaking acceptance criterion 1.

The proposed flat master row repeated department, function, canonical plant, aliases and format per triple, so a conflicting alias or format would make resolution non-deterministic with no principled winner for a strict loader.

The period contract was self-contradictory: 'only loaded Actual months are selectable' excludes the required FY26-27 YTD choice, which is derived rather than loaded, and the request value and its inclusive range were never defined.
The UI abstraction budget was unjustified: 'new select/form primitives' serves no acceptance criterion and creates a component API for a single page.

Two active decisions contradicted each other: 0017's closing consequence said D-0027 stayed open and blocked planning, while 0018 explicitly resolved D-0027 with the bucket and the ledger agreed — and the draft reconciled neither.
resolutions: FALSE FINDING — verified against the working tree: .factory/stories/mis-selection/grills/requirements.json exists and is recorded with verdict pass, 6 gaps, 6 resolutions and 1 bound round. The cold reader missed it; no plan change was warranted.

Added a '## Decisions' section reconciling all 18 active decisions, naming the load-bearing ones: 0014 (this story FULFILS its deferral of the master; its balanced budget allocation stays deferred), 0016 (partially revisited by 0017 — cost centres are a filter, never a join key/Budget grain/output dimension), 0017, 0018, 0004/0015/0009, and 0012 (its vendored-API deviation does NOT cover this story's fresh routes).

The plan now requires named request/response DTOs and documented Swagger error responses on both new routes, explicitly noting that the 0012 / D-0020 vendored deviation applies only to the vendored controllers, not to fresh code.

Surface Impact now lists the changed test and config surfaces (the pinned composed/validator tests, the warehouse db tests and golden fixture, backend/package.json, quality-gate, the app-shell tests) plus an explicit 'Unchanged by design' row (view bodies, executor authorization, %-nil CASE, zero-fill, provenance, Budget grain, ingestion raw retention). The Verify Plan now gives exact commands with their falsifying conditions, including the pinned D-0008 host command and the dead-port negative control.

Server-owned boundary: TWO authenticated documented routes — options (master-derived selector choices) and run. The run request accepts ONLY {department, function, plant, period} and never triples, GL codes, format ids or scope; the server resolves via the master, authorizes, and invokes the EXISTING governed executor. The escalation seam is closed by construction and the single governed path is preserved.

Restrict budget_src to the resolved master GL set while keeping its (gl_code, month) grain — compatible with 0017, which forbids re-graining Budget but not filtering it. HUMAN-decided extension (round): a budget GL present in the active batch but ABSENT from the master mirrors into the same unmapped-GL bucket, so both sides stay complete and reconcilable instead of silently truncated.

One versioned master with TWO record kinds: selection records keyed by (department, function, plant_canonical) owning the aliases and mis_format — making alias authority genuinely singular and doubling as the selector's option source — plus entry records mapping (cost_center, gl_code) -> mis_line with provisional and reason. The loader rejects duplicate selection keys, so resolution is deterministic.

Options are the loaded Actual months (July 2026 today) PLUS one derived 'fy26-27-ytd' option; the server resolves it as 2026-04-01 through the latest active loaded month, never the wall clock, so the API and UI cannot disagree.

No new shared component API for one page: styled NATIVE <select> controls local to the MIS page (matching the prototype's four selects) plus the existing Button. A shared primitive is promoted only when a second consumer exists.

0018 GOVERNS the bucket question. Decision 0017 has been amended in place with a dated supersession note removing its stale 'D-0027 stays open / planning cannot converge' consequence, and the plan's Decisions section states the precedence explicitly. The ledger already records D-0027 as done.
open_items: Reconciling the provisional master against Srihari's authoritative Master Table remains the spec's open item; the unmapped-GL bucket contents are the artifact that drives it.
The finished hierarchical statement, its rendering of the unmapped-GL line, and the Excel export belong to mis-statement; actuals drill-down belongs to drill-down.
The balanced budget allocation stays deferred (0014/0016) — 0017 keeps Budget at (gl_code, month).

rounds.question: mis-selection plan grill found a real bug: today the Budget side of the join admits EVERY active DUB budget GL, so a mapped selection can return Budget rows for GLs outside its resolved set — breaking acceptance criterion 1 ('exactly the DUB nursery slice'). The fix is to restrict Budget to the resolved master GL set. But that creates a mirror of the Actuals gap decision 0018 solved: Budget GLs present in the active budget batch but ABSENT from the mapping master would silently vanish from the report. How should unmapped BUDGET GLs be handled?

summary: One cold read of the plan draft returned ten gaps. One was FALSE (the requirements grill is recorded — verified: verdict pass, 6 gaps, 1 bound round). Eight are repository/decision-answerable and resolved in the amended plan: a Decisions section reconciling all 18 actives (0014 is fulfilled, not contradicted; 0012's vendored deviation does not excuse fresh routes from DTOs/Swagger); expanded Surface Impact with test/config and unchanged-by-design rows; a Verify Plan of exact falsifying commands including the pinned D-0008 host proof and dead-port control; a server-owned options/run boundary whose run request cannot carry scope, closing an escalation seam; a normalized two-record master making alias authority singular and resolution deterministic; loaded months plus a server-derived fy26-27-ytd; native selects instead of a premature component API; and an in-place amendment to 0017 removing its stale D-0027 consequence so 0018 governs the bucket. One was a genuine product decision put to the human: restricting Budget to the resolved GL set fixes a real acceptance-criterion-1 defect, and unmapped Budget GLs now MIRROR into the unmapped-GL bucket so neither side is silently truncated. Verdict pass.
